item.title: Door County Residents Encouraged to Check Eligibility for FoodShare Benefits
item.description: Adam Collins -- Door County residents looking for help stretching their grocery budgets may qualify for FoodShare Wisconsin, the state's version of the federal Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program.

item.title: Wisconsin Humane Society Seeks Adopters, Fosters as Dog Numbers Climb
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Wisconsin Humane Society is calling on the Door and Kewaunee County community to help as the dog population rises at local shelters.

item.title: DMV reminds voters about photo ID rules ahead of primary
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Wisconsin Department of Motor Vehicles wants voters to be prepared for this year's elections, with the spring primary less than a week away.

item.title: Call for Art Opens for Sturgeon Bay Waterfront Exhibit
item.description: Adam Collins -- Sturgeon Bay is inviting artists to submit proposals for a new outdoor sculpture to be featured along the city's East Waterfront Promenade as part of its Biennial Public Art Placement program.

item.title: Sister Bay man injured in single-vehicle crash
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A 34-year-old Sister Bay man suffered minor injuries and was cited for operating under the influence and inattentive driving after a single-vehicle crash in the Town of Liberty Grove.

item.title: Re-listed Baileys Harbor shipwreck added to National Register of Historic Places
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A shipwreck near Baileys Harbor that had gone by a different name for more than 20 years has now been added to the National Register of Historic Places.

item.title: Door County Advances Plan for Mid-County EMS Ambulance Station
item.description: Adam Collins -- Door County Emergency Services is moving forward with plans to build a new mid-county ambulance station intended to significantly improve emergency response times for residents and visitors.

item.title: Warm-up could be detrimental to ice fishing conditions
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- While you may be celebrating temperatures hitting 40 degrees over the next few days, your neighbors who enjoy ice fishing and other winter sports activities may not be as excited.

item.title: Gibraltar community gathers around alum Jackson
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A week after showing its support for Sevastopol third-grader Violet Tanck at a boys basketball game earlier this week, the Gibraltar community is hoping to do the same for one of its own.

item.title: Man dies in Forestville farming accident
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The Door County Sheriff's Office is investigating a fatal farming accident that occurred on Thursday in the Town of Forestville.
